Description: Job Title: Manager, Software Engineering Location : Guadalajara, MX - Remote Clari + Salesloft are building the next era of enterprise revenue - one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue - and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future. THE OPPORTUNITY: You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing AI Platform team in the US, owning the design and build-out of our AI Context Layer - the data platform that gives our AI agents access to high-quality, well-governed context about the world they operate in. Build the technical vision and roadmap for our Context Layer: a collection of high-quality data products - including a knowledge graph, RAG engines, and retrieval/search infrastructure - that give AI agents access to the best possible context about our customers and their revenue processes. Design and own the access control and RBAC model for the context layer - a genuinely hard problem at the intersection of multi-tenant data, agent identity, and fine-grained permissions. Define and evolve the APIs, SDKs, and developer interfaces that teams use to interact with the context layer, ensuring they are ergonomic, well-documented, and built for scale. Identify data platform dependencies and work closely with data engineering to ensure the underlying data infrastructure can reliably service the context layer's needs. Drive architecture discussions, design and code reviews, and set the technical standard for how context is modeled, stored, retrieved, and governed. Address governance and security requirements around data access, lineage, and auditability in an AI context. Contribute to hiring strong and diverse talent to strengthen the team. Contribute actively to internal documentation, onboarding, and platform adoption programs to ensure the Context Layer is well-understood and widely used. In addition to working with amazing colleagues who exemplify our 'team over self' core value, you will also have the opportunity to work on impactful and revolutionary software that is changing the way sellers sell. You will have an opportunity to make a difference. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR: We're looking for a Principal Software Engineer, AIPrincipal AI Engineer to lead the design and build-out of our Context Layer - the data platform that gives our AI agents access to high-quality, well-governed context about the world they operate in. This includes a knowledge graph, RAG and retrieval systems, and the access control and governance infrastructure that sits around them. You will be the technical owner and driver of this platform, working across feature teams and data engineering to build systems that are accurate, fast, secure, and a joy to build on. This role sits alongside talented staff engineers who own specific platform domains. The principal brings cross-cutting technical leadership, roadmap synthesis, and the ability to connect the dots across those domains . If you're looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Principal AI Engineer is the career path for you! THE TEAM: The Engineering Team at Clari + Salesloft is deeply committed to building an enterprise-grade platform that serves as the backbone for our customers' most critical business process - Revenue. With an unrelenting commitment to innovation, our mission is to craft the ultimate revenue intelligence platform for our customers. Rooted in Agile principles, we foster a culture of adaptability and efficiency across all our teams. If you're energized by the prospect of contributing to a dynamic environment that emphasizes collaboration, continuous improvement, and leveraging the forefront of technology to address customer needs, we would love to meet you. The role is part of our Business Analytics Center of Excellence, where analysts are assigned to support one or more business functions. You will track paid advertising performance and translate it into metrics such as LTV and ROAS that inform budget allocation and channel strategy, from structuring the underlying data pipelines to developing the reports that help marketing and business leaders make data-driven decisions. Are you passionate about bringing rigor to how early-stage businesses measure and optimize acquisition spend from day one? If so, we encourage you to apply! This person will define the metrics that matter, measure channel and campaign performance, and develop reports that drive decisions. They will also build models, forecast outcomes, run experiments, and perform in-depth diagnostic analysis. Ultimate success goes beyond data-related activities, you’ll be delivering the “so what” that drives decisions and real business impact. It is imperative to fully understand each business (processes, objectives, organization, performance drivers, barriers), and connect the dots between paid acquisition data, marketing strategy, and financial and operational effectiveness. This role partners closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions, ensuring marketing performance insights are integrated with the broader business and revenue picture. We expect that we not only answer the question asked, but also the question that was not. This Marketing Analyst needs to build positive relationships across the organization, manage diverse stakeholders with competing and often conflicting priorities, and have a “find a way” attitude. This is a remote position. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills. Analyze data, build models, test hypotheses, find root causes, develop prototypes, forecast performance, create Tableau reports, and write SQL scripts; and extract insights from these data activities to inform marketing decisions. Build, own, and maintain the marketing data infrastructure, from ad impression and click through lead acquisition to revenue, setting up and integrating Google Analytics, Google Ads, and other paid advertising platforms as required. Rapidly assess and integrate the marketing data of newly acquired (M&A) companies, establishing tracking, attribution, and reporting so their acquisition spend is measured with the same rigor as the rest of Toptal. Measure and diagnose paid advertising performance across channels and businesses—analyzing spend efficiency, CAC, funnel conversion, lead value, ROAS, and LTV—to guide budget allocation and channel strategy. Define metrics that are independent, holistic, accurate, encourage the right behaviors, and are aligned with company strategy and objectives, including consistent definitions of LTV, ROAS, and payback across businesses. Use descriptive (what happened) and diagnostic (why did it happen) analytics to develop specific, actionable recommendations for marketing leaders and business owners. Partner closely with the Business Analyst, New Businesses and the Senior Business Analyst focused on acquisitions to connect marketing performance with revenue, unit economics, and the broader business picture. Map marketing processes and channel journeys to their corresponding data flows across acquisition, engagement, and revenue generation. Proactively identify and surface opportunities to improve efficiency, conversion, revenue generation, client and talent experience, operations, communication, systems & tools, cash usage, etc. Leverage Generative AI tools to accelerate analysis and automate reporting workflows. Demonstrated experience building or owning marketing data infrastructure (tracking, attribution, data pipelines, and reporting) is required. Experience with BI tools (Tableau, Qlik, PowerBI, etc.). Proficiency in SQL; experience with R, Python, or MATLAB is a plus. Hands-on experience using Generative AI tools such as Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT to support analysis, automation, and reporting. Experience with exploratory data analysis, prototyping, testing hypotheses, performing root cause analyses, modeling business processes, building forecasts, creating predictive models, defining metrics, and/or measuring marketing performance. Track record of linking data and analytics to marketing strategy, financial performance, and operations to drive real impact. Working knowledge of probability and statistics, experience with process improvement is a plus. Experience in a startup, early-stage business, or M&A integration environment is a plus. Proven ability to manage diverse stakeholders and balance multiple, conflicting priorities in a fast-moving environment. Ability to explain complex issues simply and intuitively, and willingness to challenge assumptions, communicate limitations, and flag blind spots. Title: Simulation Technical Expert
Description: Job Description The individual will need to use and be comfortable operating in MATLAB, Dassault and Siemens signature flagship platforms to manage model configurations and maintain synchronized, traceable connectivity between CAD, PLM, and CAE/CFD tools, while building, correlating, and optimizing finite element models against standardized load cases and boundary conditions aligned with program checkpoints to drive performance, weight, and durability outcomes. This role will also serve as the core simulation expert supporting the Mechatronic Systems team, acting as the go-to technical SME to develop and facilitate simulation needs and ensure mechatronic feature decisions are grounded in rigorous, well-validated simulation data. A core expectation of this position will be supporting the development and writing of advanced scripts and macros, that become reusable tools for global rollout of simulation processes across the broader organisation as the industry moves toward software-based verification. Responsibilities In this position, you will: Simulation Technical Authority (Generative AI and MDAO): Act as the subject matter expert for adopting generative AI and multidisciplinary design optimization (MDAO) in simulation workflows. Move the team beyond manual use of commercial software toward automated, data-driven analysis and design exploration. Advanced CAE/CFD Analysis: Support System of Interest projects with subsystem- and vehicle-level analysis. Use Dassault 3DEXPERIENCE, Siemens platforms, Altair HyperWorks, Inspire/SimSolid, LS-DYNA, ADAMS and MATLAB to meet NVH, Vehicle Dynamics, and Durability KPIs, along with weight and performance targets. Proprietary Method and Algorithm Development: Develop proprietary algorithms and translation methods that convert data between disparate data sets and solvers. These methods must account for differences between static and dynamic load cases so that simulation results stay consistent across analysis conditions. Reusable Tools and Global Rollout: Support the development and writing of advanced scripts, macros, and automation pipelines. Turn them into standardized, reusable tools that enable global rollout of simulation processes across the organization as the industry moves toward software-based verification. Model Management and Traceability: Use MATLAB and the Dassault and Siemens flagship platforms to manage model configurations. Maintain synchronized, traceable connectivity between CAD, PLM, and CAE/CFD tools. Build, correlate, and optimize finite element models against standardized load cases and boundary conditions aligned with program checkpoints. System Optimization and Trade Studies: Optimize vehicle systems across cost, weight, and performance using tools such as ModeFRONTIER, 3DX Abaqus/Tosca, and Altair OptiStruct. Run MDO and sensitivity analyses to inform system selection. Mechatronics Simulation Expertise: Serve as the core simulation SME for the Mechatronic Systems team. Develop and facilitate their simulation needs so that mechatronic feature decisions rest on rigorous, well-validated data. Requirements Validation: Confirm that system requirements are applicable. Challenge requirements that lack clear legacy reasoning, and verify that system concepts are supported by simulation data. Virtual Modelling and Communication: Create virtual models on integrated platforms such as 3DX to bridge 3D CAD and CAE. Explain optimization concepts clearly to both CAD and CAE teams so turnaround is fast and needs few iterations. IP and Innovation: Identify and develop novel simulation methods, algorithms, and tools with patent potential. This supports Ford's competitive position in software-based verification. Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Automotive Engineering, or related field (PhD a plus). Experience (15+ years) in CAE, FEA/FEM and simulation-driven design/testing within automotive or similar industry. Proven expertise in tools such as Dassault 3DX, Siemens platforms, Altair Hyperworks/Optistruct, LS-Dyna, ANSYS, MATLAB, ModeFRONTIER. Demonstrated experience developing custom scripts, macros or proprietary simulation methods. Strong communication skills to bridge technical and cross-functional teams. Experience contributing to patents or technical IP is a bonus. Preferred Skills AI-driven analysis & automation: Experience applying AI/machine learning techniques to CAE/CFD workflows, simulation data processing, or predictive analytics for design optimization. Advanced scripting/programming: Proficiency in Python, MATLAB, or other scripting languages beyond basic tool operation, for developing reusable simulation tools and automation pipelines. Multidisciplinary Design Optimization (MDO) tools: Hands-on experience with ESTECO, Siemens & Dassault toolkits or similar optimization frameworks beyond foundational use. Mechatronics/electrified systems knowledge: Prior exposure to simulation of mechatronic, electrified, or software-defined vehicle features (e.g., actuators, sensors, control systems). Standards & certification knowledge: Familiarity with automotive industry standards for NVH, durability, or structural validation (e.g., SAE, ISO). Six Sigma / Lean methodologies: Exposure to structured problem-solving or continuous improvement frameworks applied to engineering processes. Establish a clear funnel model with customer stages, conversion points, leading indicators, lagging indicators, and cross-functional ownership. Identify and prioritize growth opportunities using customer, vehicle, behavioral, commercial, and channel data. Define growth hypotheses, target audiences, value propositions, success criteria, and expected business impact. Partner with Sales, Marketing, Digital Commerce, Product, Analytics, Contact Center, Dealers, Media, and GM enterprise teams to align priorities and execution. CRM and lifecycle marketing Build customer-centric lifecycle programs supporting acquisition, vehicle attach, onboarding, activation, usage, engagement, renewal, retention, and winback. Define segments, lifecycle stages, eligibility rules, suppression logic, propensity-based audiences, and next-best-action opportunities. Use personalization and behavioral signals to improve message relevance, timing, channel selection, and offer fit. Design connected journeys that reduce friction between marketing, product, commerce, support, dealer, and contact-center interactions. Develop reusable lifecycle playbooks and journey components that can scale across customer segments and priorities. Experimentation and optimization Establish a structured test-and-learn program across audiences, offers, messaging, creative, channels, timing, landing pages, onboarding flows, and journey design. Create test roadmaps with clear hypotheses, control groups, success metrics, guardrails, and decision rules. Use A/B testing, holdouts, incrementality testing, customer research, and behavioral analysis to assess true impact. Turn results into documented learnings, optimization actions, and reusable growth principles. Promote rapid learning while protecting customer experience, brand standards, privacy, and operational quality. Digital commerce and conversion Partner with Digital Commerce and Product teams to improve subscription purchase, vehicle attach, conversion, onboarding, and post-purchase engagement. Coordinate campaign links, offers, product information, landing pages, customer journeys, and measurement across digital experiences. Support launches and platform changes with communications, journey readiness, testing, issue resolution, and post-launch optimization. Connect acquisition and lifecycle programs to subscription revenue, customer value, and retention outcomes—not only engagement metrics. Measurement, data, and operations Define scorecards for CRM, lifecycle, digital commerce, media, customer engagement, and commercial performance. Monitor subscriber growth, attach, activation, conversion, renewal, churn, winback, incremental lift, customer lifetime value, acquisition cost, and return on investment. Establish consistent definitions for funnel stages, cohorts, attribution, incrementality, and performance reporting. Partner with Data, Analytics, IT, agencies, and platform owners to resolve data, integration, identity, consent, and execution issues. Improve audience quality, speed to market, data availability, campaign reliability, and automation through standardized processes. Translate business needs into actionable CRM, analytics, experimentation, and marketing-technology requirements. Cross-functional program leadership Serve as the CRM and Growth Marketing point of contact for assigned OnStar initiatives and launches. Develop execution plans, manage milestones and dependencies, and drive decisions across teams without direct authority. Facilitate growth reviews, experiment readouts, campaign-readiness reviews, operating cadences, and post-launch retrospectives. Coordinate with US and global OnStar teams to share best practices and align reusable capabilities, processes, experimentation standards, and measurement frameworks. Support dealer, contact-center, and field enablement when growth programs affect customer handling, sales, activation, or retention. Improved digital commerce conversion and subscription revenue performance. A repeatable experimentation engine that accelerates learning and scales winning ideas. Better coordination among CRM, Digital Commerce, OneCRM, customer platforms, media, dealers, and contact-center operations. Clear visibility into funnel health, customer value, growth drivers, and return on investment. Scalable, automated, and documented processes that improve speed, quality, and repeatability. Description: Company Name: IQVIA Company Location: Mexico City, Mexico Overview The IQVIA Market Access Strategy Consulting team (MASC), is a market-leading strategy and analytics division within IQVIA that helps manufacturers in the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industry meet the challenges of today’s patient access and affordability landscape. We support manufacturers by providing deep insights into the geographic variations of patient, insurer, and prescriber behavior and thereby help manufacturers implement more effective strategies for sales execution, insurer contracting, net revenue optimization, and all varieties of patient assistance programs. The Market Access Strategy Consulting team at IQVIA recruits individuals with degrees from some of the world’s top institutions. As a new hire, you will be provided on-the-job training that will allow you to develop the skills and business acumen necessary to successfully navigate the largest and most comprehensive set of US healthcare data assets. The knowledge and experience you build as a Manager will prepare you to generate high-quality insights and analytics for senior leaders at the top pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies in the US to address a wide variety of evolving business needs. IQVIA, the Human Data Science Company™, possesses the largest and most comprehensive set of healthcare data assets in the world. Join us as we focus on using data, analytics and strategy to help healthcare clients find better solutions for their patients. Formed through the merger of IMS Health and Quintiles, IQVIA offers a broad range of solutions that harness advances in healthcare information, technology, analytics and human ingenuity to drive healthcare forward. Position Overview Managers play an important leadership role on the Market Access Strategy Consulting team. After receiving training, Managers are expected to quickly contribute to all aspects of client engagements and are responsible for leading multiple consulting projects, maintaining client relationships, assisting in writing project proposals, and managing the work of 5-10 junior colleagues staffed to your respective assignments. The leadership, analytical guidance, and creativity of our Managers’ work is critical to the success of our engagement teams and our practice. Key Responsibilities Lead multiple project teams to ensure effective planning, organizing, and management of strategic analyses using a wide variety of “Big Data” assets (IQVIA and external) to derive trends, conclusions, and actionable recommendations and solutions for clients. Lead internal brainstorming sessions and the collaborating of engagement team members throughout client engagements. Synthesize complex data and information into actionable results and recommendations from the evaluation of secondary data sources to answer a wide range of market, therapeutic, prescriber, patient, payer, and competitive related questions. Lead team in the design and execution of sophisticated predictive models to inform contracting strategies, patient cost and affordability programs, prescriber utilization, and brand performance / financial modeling. Design, structure, and deliver reports, presentations and other client deliverables. Develop client relationships through effective communication (face-to-face discussions, workshops, telephone, email contact, etc.) and be a thought partner to client teams. Manage the work of junior team members across multiple client engagements. Oversee the development project work plans for engagement teams. Excellent conversational and business English (written and oral); C1 or C2 level Exceptional IT literacy e.g. Word, PowerPoint, Excel (SQL is a plus). A willingness or ability to travel as needed (10-25% on average). The team helps customers understand Watershed’s data requirements, advises them on data best practices, transforms their data into Watershed’s templates, and documents the steps for traceability. This work gets customers’ data into the platform quickly and accurately, allowing them to spend more time on their sustainability goals. Coach your team on communication and customer-facing skills. Title: Operations & Growth Sr. Manager - Americas
Description: Inspired Education is the leading global group of premium schools, with a portfolio of 126 premium private schools in 28 countries spanning 6 continents which utilise proven educational practices from every corner of the globe, ensuring over 95,000 students receive a world-class learning experience from Kindergarten to Year 13. Founded in 2013 by Nadim M. Nsouli, Inspired is backed by investors such as Stonepeak, GIC, TA Associates, and the Oppenheimer and Mansour family offices. ROLE SUMMARY: Inspired Education is a leading global group of premium schools, educating more than 95,000 students across over 125 schools on six continents. Inspired offers a world-class education built around academic excellence, sports, performing arts, and character development, providing students with exceptional opportunities to thrive both locally and globally. Inspired Education is seeking to appoint an Operations & Growth Senior Manager – Americas to support our portfolio of premium schools across the Americas. Based in Mexico City and reporting directly to the CEO, North America, this is a high-impact, hands-on role that will work closely with the Americas Executive Team to drive commercial growth, operational excellence, and business transformation across the region. This role is designed for a highly analytical, execution-oriented professional who enjoys solving complex business challenges, leading cross-functional initiatives, and turning insights into action. Working alongside Heads of School and regional functional leaders, the Operations & Growth Senior Manager will identify opportunities to improve commercial performance, streamline operations, enhance cross-functional collaboration, and deliver measurable business improvements. This is an exceptional opportunity for someone who combines a consulting toolkit with operational experience and has a passion for building, scaling, and improving businesses. We are looking for someone who is energized by creating new processes, solving ambiguous problems, and helping organisations grow through execution. Drive initiatives that accelerate commercial growth by improving sales performance, conversion, customer journey, and revenue generation across the region. Lead strategic projects that improve operational excellence and business performance across existing schools. Drive cross-functional improvement initiatives across Commercial, Operations, Finance, Marketing, and HR that enhance business performance and execution. Identify and remove operational bottlenecks across Finance, Marketing, HR, Commercial, and School Operations through data analysis, stakeholder engagement, and process improvement. Lead initiatives to optimise transportation, catering, uniforms, facilities, procurement, extracurricular programmes, and other support services. Develop business cases, dashboards, and performance reporting that enable data-driven decision making across the region. Coordinate strategic projects from diagnosis through implementation, ensuring clear ownership, measurable outcomes, and successful execution. Partner with regional functional experts to standardise best practices, improve processes, and drive operational consistency across schools. Support the integration of newly acquired schools when required, ensuring a smooth transition into Inspired's operating model and best practices. Build strong relationships with school leadership teams and regional stakeholders, acting as a trusted partner in delivering meaningful business improvements. Present insights, recommendations, and project updates directly to the CEO and regional leadership team. Travel across the Americas as required to support schools, understand operational challenges firsthand, and ensure successful implementation of key initiatives. You are someone who enjoys creating structure where it doesn't yet exist. Experience working in a fast-paced startup, scale-up, or multinational environment where resourcefulness, ownership, and execution are essential to success. Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional projects from diagnosis through implementation, delivering measurable business impact. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data, identify trends, and develop practical recommendations. Experience analysing commercial performance, sales funnels, customer journeys, and operational KPIs. Strong financial and commercial acumen with the ability to build business cases and evaluate operational improvement opportunities.
